channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli air strikes in Gaza kill 7 as doctors warn of meningitis outbreak
item.description: Gaza health officials say meningitis cases rose to 272 in October, more than eight times the typical monthly rate.

item.title: Russian strike kills two in Ukraine, days after ship attack off Libya
item.description: Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia destroyed a house and damaged a five-storey apartment building, Ukrainian officials said.

item.title: Why has Yemen’s offensive against the Houthis in al-Bayda stalled?
item.description: Government forces made early gains in September, but Houthi fighting on multiple fronts has slowed the offensive.

item.title: Pennsylvania reports ninth measles death in ongoing state outbreak
item.description: CDC and state figures on measles deaths differ as Pennsylvania faces an escalating health crisis in 46 counties.

item.title: Car bomb strikes governor’s office in Meta, Colombia
item.description: A car bomb exploded in the city of Villavicencio in Colombia’s Meta Department.

item.title: Qatar PM looks to revive US-Iran talks after meeting Rubio
item.description: Qatar’s Prime Minister says he’s working towards deescalating tensions between Iran and the US.

item.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
item.description: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.

item.title: Israeli attacks have turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland', Oxfam says
item.description: The report says there are signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza as a result of Israel's actions.

item.title: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
item.description: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.
